items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Recommendation: keep new public exposure and security-sensitive releases gated; permit ordinary reversible growth only within existing consent, disclosure, data-handling, and rollback boundaries. Evidence: security snapshot generated 2026-09-30T22:50:04.738Z reports fleet-doctor unavailable with no run, findings, or site checks across 61 sites; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; authentication boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are therefore unevidenced. TLS has no certificates expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance reports 36 pass, 19 fail, and 6 unknown across 61 sites, including consent/banner/GA4 and privacy/terms failures; this is a technical baseline, not certification. Exact decision: retain the existing private/security-sensitive gates, do not claim clearance, and continue only bounded read-only evidence work. The existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement may remain capacity-gated and proceed only after CTO releases a slot and normal validation confirms no new credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior.
